text:
Predicates:
NLPTask(x) ::: x is a natural language processing task.
Generation(x) ::: x is a language generation task.
Understanding(x) ::: x is a language understanding task.
OutputIsTextSequence(x) ::: the output of x is a text sequence.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: x is machine translation.
Conclusion:
NLPTask(x) ∧ OutputIsTextSequence(x) → Generation(x) ::: If a natural language processing task's output is a text sequence, then it is a language generation task.
MachineTranslation(x) → Generation(x) ::: Machine translation is a natural language processing task that outputs a text sequence.
